title: 第21章 武当之巅万剑臣服第22章 天剑之名
lines: 江寒受到燕狂徒的狂气影响，此刻只觉浑身热血沸腾。
人生在世，当如是！
“好，万剑归宗，还请各位前辈品鉴！”
江寒伸出一只手，双指成剑，引动体内剑气。
顿时一股冲天剑意直插云霄，刺破头顶乌云。
武当山上的所有剑器，此刻都受到江寒感召。
仿佛活了过来，发出嗡嗡铮鸣。
锵铮！
一声如夜莺般的脆鸣，第一把剑脱离剑鞘，一路飞向后山。
其余剑器都像是受到感召，纷纷从剑鞘中挣脱，汇往武当后山。
还在山路上的中唐皇族，李世民以及李秀宁，发现自己的佩剑不听话，无论他们怎样压制，佩剑都在挣扎，到最后挣脱出手，径直飞往山上。
不仅是二人，身后护卫的佩剑，也全都遁入山中。
抬头望去，身前身后，无数的剑器全都隐入武当后山的云层之上。
跟在二位身边的李靖和秦叔宝等人，一脸惊愕。
“这等对剑器的召唤，难道是张真人亲自出手？”
走在山腰的南明皇族，铁胆神侯朱无视，带着手下天地玄三位密探登山。
朱无视和段天涯用尽全力，都没能阻止佩剑，两把武器同时遁没。
“义父，这……”段天涯满脸惊愕，不知道发生了什么情况。
反观朱无视，面色阴沉，眺望云卷云舒汇集了无数剑器的后山，眼睛微眯：
“不知道这招是燕狂徒还是萧秋水的。只是如此惊人可以统御万剑的剑术，之前江湖上从来都没出现过。”
北宋来访的四大名捕，以及神通侯方应看，其中方应看和冷血都是用剑之人。
方应看的血河神剑，冷血的刀片似的短剑，陪伴了他们十几年的老伙计，在这一刻却都努力挣扎，挣脱了它们原本的主人。
像是朝拜般往一处汇集。
这些国家组织，来之前都是得到消息的。
三位超绝的甲子之约，亦是这次的看点。
“这等御剑术，难道是萧前辈又突破了？”
神通侯方应看攥紧拳头，一脸怒容：“我不管是谁，血河神剑丢了便是死罪，我一定要夺回来！”
思索好奇间，几人的脚步不由加快，快速朝武当山广场走去。
还在武当山路上的人，自然不清楚后山发生了什么。
但是在大殿前广场上看热闹的武林人士，都知道这御剑之术，来自于深藏不露的狂士江寒。
这等统御万剑的招式，完全超出了他们的想象。
以此等实力御剑，今后只要是使剑的高手，在江寒面前恐再无立足之地！
不仅是在场众人的剑器，武当所有弟子的佩剑、连同在内堂奉起的张三丰的真武佩剑，也一并受到感召，出现在云海后山之上。
无数的剑器悬于天空，发出铮铮幽鸣。
燕狂徒、张三丰以及萧秋水，都看到了这漫天的剑器。
拱卫在江寒身后，寒气逼人。
江寒双指一点，对准袭来的黑色剑气，身后的无数剑器嗡鸣作响。
如同海里的鱼群，形成一串，密集地朝黑色剑气撞去。
浩大的场面，甚至将顶峰上的云雾拨散。
content_en:
Jiang Han was affected by the madness of Yan Kuangtui, and at this moment he felt his blood boiling all over his body.
Life should be like this!
"Okay, Wan Jian has returned to the sect, and I would like to invite you seniors to taste it!"
Jiang Han stretched out a hand and turned his fingers into a sword, activating the sword energy in his body.
Suddenly, a soaring sword intent shot straight into the sky, piercing the dark clouds above his head.
All the swords on Wudang Mountain are inspired by Jiang Han at this moment.
It seemed to have come to life and made a buzzing sound.
Clang!
With a crisp cry like a nightingale, the first sword came out of its scabbard and flew all the way to the back mountain.
The other swords seemed to be inspired, and they broke free from their scabbards and went to the back mountain of Wudang.
The royal family of the Mid-Tang Dynasty, Li Shimin and Li Xiuning, who were still on the mountain road, found that their swords were not obedient. No matter how they suppressed them, the swords struggled, and finally broke free and flew straight to the mountain.
Not only the two of them, but also the swords guarding them behind them all fled into the mountains.
Looking up, in front of and behind him, countless swords were hidden in the clouds at the back of Wudang Mountain.
Li Jing, Qin Shubao and others who were following the two of them looked shocked.
"Could it be that Master Zhang himself did this summoning of swords?"
The Nanming royal family was walking on the mountainside, and the iron-courage god Hou Zhu ignored him and took his three spies, Tian Di Xuan, to climb the mountain.
Zhu Wuwu and Duan Tianya tried their best, but they were unable to stop the swords, and the two weapons escaped at the same time.
"Father, this..." Duan Tianya was shocked, not knowing what was going on.
Zhu Wuwang, on the other hand, looked gloomy, looking at the back mountain where Yunjuan Yunshu gathered countless swords, and narrowed his eyes slightly:
"I don't know if this move belongs to Yan Kuangtu or Xiao Qiushui. It's just that such amazing swordsmanship that can control ten thousand swords has never been seen in the world before."
The four famous arresters who visited in the Northern Song Dynasty, as well as Shen Tonghou Fang Yingkan, among them Fang Yingkan and Lengxue were both swordsmen.
Fang Ying looked at the Blood River Divine Sword, a cold-blooded blade-like dagger, which had been with them for more than ten years. At this moment, they struggled hard to break away from their original owner.
They gather in one place like a pilgrimage.
These national organizations were informed before coming.
The agreement between three extraordinary people is also the highlight of this time.
"Could it be that Senior Xiao has made another breakthrough in this level of sword control?"
Shentong Hou Fangying clenched his fists and said with an angry face: "I don't care who it is, losing the Blood River Divine Sword is a death penalty, I must take it back!"
While thinking and curious, several people couldn't help but quicken their steps and quickly walked towards Wudang Mountain Square.
People who are still on the road to Wudang Mountain naturally don’t know what happened in the back mountain.
But the martial arts people watching the excitement in the square in front of the main hall all know that this sword-controlling skill comes from the secretive madman Jiang Han.
These moves to control ten thousand swords were completely beyond their imagination.
With such strength in wielding a sword, from now on any master who wields a sword may no longer have a foothold in front of Jiang Han!
Not only the swords of everyone present, but also the swords of all Wudang disciples, as well as Zhang Sanfeng's Zhenwu sword enshrined in the inner hall, were also inspired and appeared on the mountain behind the sea of ​​clouds.
Countless swords hung in the sky, making clanging sounds.
Kuangtu Yan, Zhang Sanfeng and Xiao Qiushui all saw the swords filling the sky.
The guards stood behind Jiang Han, and the cold air was overwhelming.
Jiang Han pointed his fingers at the incoming black sword energy, and countless swords behind him buzzed.
Like a school of fish in the sea, they formed a string and crashed densely towards the black sword energy.
The majestic scene even dispersed the clouds and mist on the summit.
title_en: Chapter 21: Ten thousand swords surrender at the top of Wudang Chapter 22: The name of Heavenly Sword
